mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of quarters following YoY GDP acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE drops below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of quarters following a YoY drop in INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in housing starts, as measured by the year-over-year change in the HOUST index, signals a strengthening housing market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of months following a YoY rise in HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate, combined with a flattening yield curve, signals a tightening monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% and the yield curve flattens.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in nonfarm payrolls, as measured by the year-over-year change in the PAYEMS index, signals a strengthening labor market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of months following a YoY rise in PAYEMS.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales, as measured by the year-over-year change in the RSAFS index, signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of quarters following a YoY drop in RSAFS.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index, as measured by the year-over-year change in the CPIAUCSL index, signals rising inflation that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of months following a CPIAUCSL YoY change above 3%.
